                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        本文深入解析 Mem0 记忆添加机制，揭示其双存储架构（向量存储+图存储）如何实现智能记忆管理。通过源码剖析，详解 LLM 驱动的事实提取、相似性检索、增删改决策等核心流程，展现 Mem0 如何用提示词工程实现高效记忆生命周期管理，适合开发者理解 AI 记忆系统设计。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<blockquote>
<p>这是 Mem0 源码解析系列的第一篇文章。我们将深入探讨 Mem0 的核心功能——记忆添加机制，理解其背后的设计思路和实现细节。</p>
</blockquote>
<p><a href="https://www.feifeixu.me/article/mem0-source-code-analysis-2" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">原文</a></p>
<h2 id="一引言">一、引言</h2>
<p>Mem0（"mem-zero"）是一个为 AI 应用提供长期记忆层的开源项目。它能让 AI 助手记住用户偏好、适应个性化需求，并持续学习——非常适合客户支持聊天机器人、AI 助手和自主系统等场景。</p>
<p><img alt="Mem0 概念与应用场景" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Lrcx/image-repo@master/blogs/20260409180123843.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>在阅读源码之前，我一直好奇：</p>
<ul>
<li>Mem0 是如何从对话中提取有价值的信息？</li>
<li>它如何决定是添加新记忆、更新旧记忆，还是删除过期记忆？</li>
<li>向量存储和图存储分别扮演什么角色？</li>
</ul>
<p>带着这些问题，让我们开始探索。</p>
<h2 id="二整体架构">二、整体架构</h2>
<p>Mem0 的记忆添加流程可以概括为以下架构：</p>
<p><img alt="整体架构流程图" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Lrcx/image-repo@master/blogs/20260409180123844.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>核心文件位于 <code>mem0/memory/main.py</code>，主要涉及：</p>
<ul>
<li><code>Memory.add()</code>：入口方法</li>
<li><code>_add_to_vector_store()</code>：向量存储逻辑</li>
<li><code>_add_to_graph()</code>：图存储逻辑</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="三入口方法memoryadd">三、入口方法：<code>Memory.add()</code></h2>
<p>让我们从入口方法开始（位于 <code>mem0/memory/main.py:281</code>）：</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">def add(
    self,
    messages,
    *,
    user_id: Optional[str] = None,
    agent_id: Optional[str] = None,
    run_id: Optional[str] = None,
    metadata: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    infer: bool = True,
    memory_type: Optional[str] = None,
    prompt: Optional[str] = None,
):
</code></pre>
<h3 id="31-参数解析">3.1 参数解析</h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>messages</strong>：输入内容，可以是字符串、字典或消息列表</p>
<ul>
<li>字符串：<code>"我喜欢喝咖啡"</code></li>
<li>单条消息：<code>{"role": "user", "content": "我喜欢喝咖啡"}</code></li>
<li>消息列表：<code>[{"role": "user", "content": "..."}, {"role": "assistant", "content": "..."}]</code></li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>user_id/agent_id/run_id</strong>：会话标识符，用于隔离不同用户/会话的记忆</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>infer</strong>：是否使用 LLM 推理（默认 True）</p>
<ul>
<li>True：提取事实并智能管理记忆</li>
<li>False：直接存储原始消息</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>memory_type</strong>：记忆类型（如 "procedural_memory" 用于程序性记忆）</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="32-核心流程">3.2 核心流程</h3>
<p><code>add()</code> 方法的核心逻辑（简化版）：</p>
<pre><code class="language-python"># 1. 构建元数据和过滤条件
processed_metadata, effective_filters = _build_filters_and_metadata(
    user_id=user_id, agent_id=agent_id, run_id=run_id, input_metadata=metadata
)

# 2. 处理特殊记忆类型（如程序性记忆）
if agent_id is not None and memory_type == MemoryType.PROCEDURAL.value:
    return self._create_procedural_memory(messages, metadata=processed_metadata)

# 3. 并行执行向量存储和图存储添加
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor() as executor:
    future1 = executor.submit(self._add_to_vector_store, messages, processed_metadata, effective_filters, infer)
    future2 = executor.submit(self._add_to_graph, messages, effective_filters)
    
    concurrent.futures.wait([future1, future2])
    
    vector_store_result = future1.result()
    graph_result = future2.result()

# 4. 返回结果
return {"results": vector_store_result, "relations": graph_result}
</code></pre>
<p>这里有个关键设计：<strong>并行执行</strong>。向量存储和图存储的添加是独立进行的，提高了效率。</p>
<h2 id="四向量存储添加_add_to_vector_store">四、向量存储添加：<code>_add_to_vector_store()</code></h2>
<p>这是最核心的部分，位于 <code>mem0/memory/main.py:386</code>。</p>
<h3 id="41-两种模式">4.1 两种模式</h3>
<h4 id="模式一inferfalse直接存储">模式一：<code>infer=False</code>（直接存储）</h4>
<p>当 <code>infer=False</code> 时，不经过 LLM 处理，直接存储原始消息：</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">if not infer:
    for message_dict in messages:
        # 跳过系统消息
        if message_dict["role"] == "system":
            continue
        
        # 生成 embedding
        msg_embeddings = self.embedding_model.embed(msg_content, "add")
        
        # 直接创建记忆
        mem_id = self._create_memory(msg_content, msg_embeddings, per_msg_meta)
        
        returned_memories.append({
            "id": mem_id,
            "memory": msg_content,
            "event": "ADD"
        })
    return returned_memories
</code></pre>
<h4 id="模式二infertrue智能推理">模式二：<code>infer=True</code>（智能推理）</h4>
<p>这是默认模式，流程更复杂：</p>
<p><img alt="智能推理四步流程" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Lrcx/image-repo@master/blogs/20260409180123845.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="42-步骤详解">4.2 步骤详解</h3>
<h4 id="步骤1提取事实">步骤1：提取事实</h4>
<p>使用 LLM 从对话中提取有价值的"事实"：</p>
<pre><code class="language-python"># 选择提示词（用户记忆 vs Agent记忆）
is_agent_memory = self._should_use_agent_memory_extraction(messages, metadata)
system_prompt, user_prompt = get_fact_retrieval_messages(parsed_messages, is_agent_memory)

# 调用 LLM
response = self.llm.generate_response(
    messages=[
        {"role": "system", "content": system_prompt},
        {"role": "user", "content": user_prompt}
    ],
    response_format={"type": "json_object"}
)

# 解析 JSON 结果
new_retrieved_facts = json.loads(response)["facts"]
</code></pre>
<p>提示词示例（位于 <code>mem0/configs/prompts.py:14</code>）：</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">FACT_RETRIEVAL_PROMPT = """You are a Personal Information Organizer...

Types of Information to Remember:
1. Store Personal Preferences
2. Maintain Important Personal Details
3. Track Plans and Intentions
...

Input: Hi, my name is John. I am a software engineer.
Output: {"facts": ["Name is John", "Is a Software engineer"]}
"""
</code></pre>
<h4 id="步骤2搜索相似记忆">步骤2：搜索相似记忆</h4>
<p>对每个新提取的事实，在向量数据库中搜索相似的记忆：</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">for new_mem in new_retrieved_facts:
    # 生成 embedding
    messages_embeddings = self.embedding_model.embed(new_mem, "add")
    
    # 搜索相似记忆（向量相似度）
    existing_memories = self.vector_store.search(
        query=new_mem,
        vectors=messages_embeddings,
        limit=5,
        filters=search_filters
    )
    
    for mem in existing_memories:
        retrieved_old_memory.append({"id": mem.id, "text": mem.payload.get("data", "")})
</code></pre>
<h4 id="步骤3决定操作类型">步骤3：决定操作类型</h4>
<p>使用 LLM 分析新旧记忆，决定操作类型：</p>
<p><img alt="四种操作类型决策图" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Lrcx/image-repo@master/blogs/20260409180123846.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>决策提示词（位于 <code>mem0/configs/prompts.py:175</code>）定义了四种操作：</p>
<pre><code class="language-python"># 构建决策提示词
function_calling_prompt = get_update_memory_messages(
    retrieved_old_memory, new_retrieved_facts
)

# LLM 返回操作决策
response = self.llm.generate_response(
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": function_calling_prompt}],
    response_format={"type": "json_object"}
)

new_memories_with_actions = json.loads(response)
</code></pre>
<p>决策提示词（位于 <code>mem0/configs/prompts.py:175</code>）定义了四种操作：</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">DEFAULT_UPDATE_MEMORY_PROMPT = """You are a smart memory manager...

Compare newly retrieved facts with the existing memory. For each new fact, decide whether to:
- ADD: Add it to the memory as a new element
- UPDATE: Update an existing memory element  
- DELETE: Delete an existing memory element
- NONE: Make no change
"""
</code></pre>
<p>示例决策过程：</p>
<pre><code class="language-json">{
  "memory": [
    {
      "id": "0",
      "text": "Likes cheese and chicken pizza",  // UPDATE: 更新口味偏好
      "event": "UPDATE",
      "old_memory": "Likes cheese pizza"
    },
    {
      "id": "1",
      "text": "Name is John",  // NONE: 已存在，无需操作
      "event": "NONE"
    },
    {
      "id": "2",
      "text": "Dislikes cats",  // ADD: 新增记忆
      "event": "ADD"
    }
  ]
}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="步骤4执行操作">步骤4：执行操作</h4>
<p>根据决策结果执行相应的 CRUD 操作：</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">for resp in new_memories_with_actions.get("memory", []):
    action_text = resp.get("text")
    event_type = resp.get("event")
    
    if event_type == "ADD":
        memory_id = self._create_memory(action_text, existing_embeddings, metadata)
        
    elif event_type == "UPDATE":
        self._update_memory(
            memory_id=temp_uuid_mapping[resp.get("id")],
            data=action_text,
            existing_embeddings=existing_embeddings,
            metadata=metadata
        )
        
    elif event_type == "DELETE":
        self._delete_memory(memory_id=temp_uuid_mapping[resp.get("id")])
        
    elif event_type == "NONE":
        # 无需操作
        pass
</code></pre>
<h3 id="43-记忆创建细节">4.3 记忆创建细节</h3>
<p><code>_create_memory()</code> 方法（<code>mem0/memory/main.py:1075</code>）：</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">def _create_memory(self, data, existing_embeddings, metadata=None):
    # 生成唯一 ID
    memory_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
    
    # 构建 metadata
    metadata["data"] = data
    metadata["hash"] = hashlib.md5(data.encode()).hexdigest()
    metadata["created_at"] = datetime.now(pytz.timezone("US/Pacific")).isoformat()
    
    # 存入向量数据库
    self.vector_store.insert(
        vectors=[embeddings],
        ids=[memory_id],
        payloads=[metadata]
    )
    
    # 记录历史（SQLite）
    self.db.add_history(memory_id, None, data, "ADD", ...)
    
    return memory_id
</code></pre>
<h2 id="五图存储添加_add_to_graph">五、图存储添加：<code>_add_to_graph()</code></h2>
<p>图存储用于存储实体和关系，适合处理复杂的知识网络。</p>
<h3 id="51-入口方法">5.1 入口方法</h3>
<p>位于 <code>mem0/memory/main.py:599</code>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">def _add_to_graph(self, messages, filters):
    if self.enable_graph:
        # 合并消息内容
        data = "\n".join([msg["content"] for msg in messages if msg["role"] != "system"])
        
        # 调用图存储添加
        added_entities = self.graph.add(data, filters)
        
    return added_entities
</code></pre>
<h3 id="52-图存储核心逻辑">5.2 图存储核心逻辑</h3>
<p>位于 <code>mem0/memory/graph_memory.py:76</code>，主要步骤：</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">def add(self, data, filters):
    # 1. 提取实体
    entity_type_map = self._retrieve_nodes_from_data(data, filters)
    
    # 2. 建立实体关系
    to_be_added = self._establish_nodes_relations_from_data(data, filters, entity_type_map)
    
    # 3. 搜索图数据库中的相似节点
    search_output = self._search_graph_db(node_list=list(entity_type_map.keys()), filters=filters)
    
    # 4. 决定需要删除的实体（矛盾关系）
    to_be_deleted = self._get_delete_entities_from_search_output(search_output, data, filters)
    
    # 5. 执行删除和添加
    deleted_entities = self._delete_entities(to_be_deleted, filters)
    added_entities = self._add_entities(to_be_added, filters, entity_type_map)
    
    return {"deleted_entities": deleted_entities, "added_entities": added_entities}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="53-实体提取示例">5.3 实体提取示例</h3>
<p>使用 LLM 提取实体和类型：</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">entity_type_map = self._retrieve_nodes_from_data(data, filters)
# 结果示例：
# {
#   "john": "person",
#   "coffee": "drink",
#   "starbucks": "brand"
# }
</code></pre>
<h3 id="54-关系建立示例">5.4 关系建立示例</h3>
<p>使用 LLM 建立实体间的关系：</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">entities = self._establish_nodes_relations_from_data(data, filters, entity_type_map)
# 结果示例：
# [
#   {"source": "john", "relationship": "likes", "destination": "coffee"},
#   {"source": "coffee", "relationship": "brand", "destination": "starbucks"}
# ]
</code></pre>
<p>最终存入 Neo4j 图数据库：</p>
<pre><code>(john:Person) -[:LIKES]-&gt; (coffee:Drink) -[:BRAND]-&gt; (starbucks:Brand)
</code></pre>
<h2 id="六关键组件介绍">六、关键组件介绍</h2>
<h3 id="61-llm-工厂模式">6.1 LLM 工厂模式</h3>
<p>Mem0 使用工厂模式支持多种 LLM：</p>
<pre><code class="language-python"># mem0/utils/factory.py
class LlmFactory:
    provider_to_class = {
        "openai": ("mem0.llms.openai.OpenAILLM", OpenAIConfig),
        "anthropic": ("mem0.llms.anthropic.AnthropicLLM", AnthropicConfig),
        "azure_openai": ("mem0.llms.azure_openai.AzureOpenAILLM", AzureOpenAIConfig),
        "gemini": ("mem0.llms.gemini.GeminiLLM", BaseLlmConfig),
        ...
    }
</code></pre>
<h3 id="62-embedding-生成">6.2 Embedding 生成</h3>
<pre><code class="language-python">class EmbedderFactory:
    provider_to_class = {
        "openai": "mem0.embeddings.openai.OpenAIEmbedding",
        "huggingface": "mem0.embeddings.huggingface.HuggingFaceEmbedding",
        ...
    }
</code></pre>
<h3 id="63-向量存储支持">6.3 向量存储支持</h3>
<pre><code class="language-python">class VectorStoreFactory:
    provider_to_class = {
        "qdrant": "mem0.vector_stores.qdrant.Qdrant",
        "chroma": "mem0.vector_stores.chroma.ChromaDB",
        "pinecone": "mem0.vector_stores.pinecone.PineconeDB",
        "milvus": "mem0.vector_stores.milvus.MilvusDB",
        "weaviate": "mem0.vector_stores.weaviate.Weaviate",
        ...
    }
</code></pre>
<h2 id="七完整流程示例">七、完整流程示例</h2>
<p>让我们用一个完整示例串联整个过程：</p>
<p><img alt="端到端示例流程" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Lrcx/image-repo@master/blogs/20260409180123848.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<pre><code class="language-python">from mem0 import Memory

memory = Memory()

# 用户对话
messages = [
    {"role": "user", "content": "我叫张三，我喜欢喝拿铁咖啡"},
    {"role": "assistant", "content": "你好张三！拿铁是很受欢迎的咖啡"}
]

# 添加记忆
result = memory.add(messages, user_id="zhangsan")

# 结果示例
{
    "results": [
        {"id": "abc123", "memory": "Name is 张三", "event": "ADD"},
        {"id": "def456", "memory": "Likes 拿铁 coffee", "event": "ADD"}
    ],
    "relations": {
        "deleted_entities": [],
        "added_entities": [
            {"source": "张三", "relationship": "likes", "target": "拿铁"}
        ]
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="流程拆解">流程拆解：</h3>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>提取事实</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>LLM 从对话中提取：<code>["Name is 张三", "Likes 拿铁 coffee"]</code></li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>搜索相似记忆</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>在向量数据库中搜索相似的记忆</li>
<li>结果：未找到相似记忆（假设是新用户）</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>决策操作</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>LLM 决定：两条事实都需要 ADD</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>执行操作</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>创建两条记忆记录</li>
<li>生成 embedding 并存入向量数据库</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>图存储</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>提取实体：<code>{"张三": "person", "拿铁": "drink"}</code></li>
<li>建立关系：<code>张三 -[:likes]-&gt; 拿铁</code></li>
<li>存入 Neo4j</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="八设计亮点">八、设计亮点</h2>
<p><img alt="设计亮点总结" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Lrcx/image-repo@master/blogs/20260409180123849.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="81-智能推理-vs-直接存储">8.1 智能推理 vs 直接存储</h3>
<p>Mem0 提供两种模式：</p>
<ul>
<li><code>infer=True</code>：智能提取、去重、更新，适合生产环境</li>
<li><code>infer=False</code>：直接存储，适合需要完整保留原始对话的场景</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="82-双存储架构">8.2 双存储架构</h3>
<p><img alt="双存储对比图" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Lrcx/image-repo@master/blogs/20260409180123847.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>向量存储</strong>：快速相似性搜索，适合检索场景</li>
<li><strong>图存储</strong>：实体关系管理，适合复杂知识网络</li>
</ul>
<p>两者互补，提供更全面的记忆能力。</p>
<h3 id="83-并行处理">8.3 并行处理</h3>
<p>向量存储和图存储并行执行，提高效率：</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor() as executor:
    future1 = executor.submit(self._add_to_vector_store, ...)
    future2 = executor.submit(self._add_to_graph, ...)
</code></pre>
<h3 id="84-提示词工程">8.4 提示词工程</h3>
<p>Mem0 的提示词设计非常精细：</p>
<ul>
<li>事实提取提示词包含详细的分类指南和示例</li>
<li>记忆更新提示词定义了清晰的 ADD/UPDATE/DELETE/NONE 规则</li>
<li>支持自定义提示词（<code>custom_fact_extraction_prompt</code>）</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="九总结">九、总结</h2>
<p>通过这次源码解析，我们了解到：</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>Mem0 的记忆添加不只是简单的存储</strong>，而是包含了：</p>
<ul>
<li>智能事实提取</li>
<li>相似性检索</li>
<li>增删改决策</li>
<li>双存储架构</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>核心设计理念</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>用 LLM 智能管理记忆生命周期</li>
<li>向量存储处理事实检索</li>
<li>图存储处理实体关系</li>
<li>并行处理提升效率</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>提示词工程是 Mem0 的核心</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>事实提取提示词定义了 7 种信息类型</li>
<li>记忆更新提示词定义了 4 种操作类型</li>
<li>这些精心设计的提示词是 Mem0 智能管理的关键</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="十系列预告">十、系列预告</h2>
<p>通过这篇文章，了解了 Mem0 的记忆添加流程，包括智能事实提取、相似性检索、增删改决策以及双存储架构。接下来，我们将深入探讨 Mem0 的提示词工程，了解如何通过精心设计的提示词来实现智能管理。</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>第二篇</strong>：提示词工程的深度解析</li>
</ul>
<p>敬请期待！</p>
<hr>
<p><strong>相关代码文件</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li><code>mem0/memory/main.py</code>：核心 Memory 类</li>
<li><code>mem0/memory/graph_memory.py</code>：图存储实现</li>
<li><code>mem0/configs/prompts.py</code>：提示词定义</li>
<li><code>mem0/utils/factory.py</code>：各种工厂类</li>
</ul>
